Title: M01-US04: Login Form Rejects Incorrect Password, Unregistered Email, Invalid Email Format, and Blank Fields
Description: Verifies that the FashionStack login form rejects five clearly separated invalid-input variations — (1) registered test email with a known incorrect but validly formatted password, (2) unregistered test email with a validly formatted password, (3) invalid email format with a validly formatted password, (4a) blank email with a validly formatted password, and (4b) registered test email with a blank password — each as a distinct numbered step with its own expected result. The login page is reset and both fields cleared between variations. Variations 1 and 2 must produce the same generic authentication error that does not reveal whether the account exists. Variation 3 must produce an invalid-email-format validation message. Variations 4a and 4b must produce required-field validation messages. After every variation the Login page remains visible, the Login control remains available, and the Logout control is not visible. Every variation must leave the user unauthenticated.

Title: M01-US01: Carousel Automatic Transition and Rapid Repeated Navigation Stability
Description: Verifies that the carousel automatically transitions between slides and that during rapid repeated navigation (five quick successive clicks on the Next control within approximately two seconds), the carousel remains stable and responsive. The automatic-transition interval is measured and recorded as T during execution. Expected results are specific and pass/fail: exactly one complete, fully rendered slide is visible after every transition; no blank, overlapping, partially rendered, or misaligned content appears; after rapid clicks the carousel is not frozen; one normal Next click advances to the next valid slide; and automatic rotation resumes within T plus two seconds of the last interaction.

Title: M01-US04: Authenticated Session Persists Across Navigation and Ends After Logout
Description: Verifies that a successfully authenticated FashionStack session remains active while the user navigates to the Men's Fashion page, the cart page, and refreshes the cart page — confirmed at each step by the Logout control being visible and the Login control being absent — and that clicking Logout fully ends the session, confirmed by the Login control becoming visible and the Logout control disappearing, and that a subsequent page refresh leaves the user in the signed-out state with Login visible and Logout absent.

Title: M01-US01: Carousel Handles Missing or Broken Slide Content Gracefully
Description: Verifies that when one carousel slide image is blocked via a browser developer tools Network request blocking rule, the affected slide displays meaningful fallback content (descriptive alt text or an intentional placeholder image — a bare browser broken-image icon without meaningful fallback is a failure), the slide's heading and text remain readable, the carousel layout does not collapse or misalign, no uncaught JavaScript exception breaks the page, the remaining two slides display correctly, and the rest of the site remains usable. After removing the blocking rule and reloading, the previously blocked image loads correctly.

Title: M01-US03: Selecting Size S and Clicking Add to Cart Updates Header Counter from 0 to 1
Description: Verifies that starting from a clean browser session with the cart counter at 0, navigating to the 'Silk Wrap Dress' product, selecting size 'S' and quantity '1', and clicking 'Add to Cart' immediately updates the header cart counter from 0 to 1.

Title: M01-US02: Clicking Men Opens Men's Fashion Page with Exactly 16 Product Listings
Description: Verifies that clicking the 'Men' link on the FashionStack homepage navigates to a page with the heading exactly reading 'Men's Fashion', that the inventory summary states '16 products', and that exactly 16 product cards are displayed on the page.

Title: M01-US03: Cart Counter Persists Across Navigation to Homepage and Cart Page
Description: Verifies that after adding 'Silk Wrap Dress' (size S, quantity 1) to the cart and the counter updates to 1, the counter value of 1 persists when the user navigates to the homepage and then to the cart page, demonstrating session state reliability.

Title: M01-US02: Product Names, Prices, and Images Display Correctly and Navigate to Detail Pages
Description: Verifies that each product card on the Men's Fashion page displays a product name, a price, a usable product image (or a defined fallback if the image is missing), and that clicking a product card navigates to the correct product detail page for that product.

Title: M01-US01: Carousel Displays All Three FashionStack Slides with Correct Content
Description: Verifies that the homepage hero carousel displays exactly three slides — 'Summer Collection 2024', 'Minimalist Essentials', and 'Premium Denim' — each with the correct heading text, supporting content, and a rendered (non-broken) image. This test ensures the carousel's core content contract is met for all three required slides.

Title: M01-US04: Valid Email-and-Password Login Succeeds and Logout Returns to Signed-Out State
Description: Verifies that a previously registered FashionStack test account can log in successfully using a valid email and password, that the authenticated state is confirmed by a visible logged-in indicator (profile/account control or equivalent stable UI element), and that logging out returns the user to a clearly signed-out state with no authenticated indicators visible.

Title: M01-US03: Repeated Product Additions and Quantity Changes Update Cart Counter Correctly
Description: Verifies that repeated additions of products to the cart and changes to product quantities correctly and synchronously update both the header cart counter and the cart contents. This edge case tests the cart counter's accuracy under multiple sequential add and quantity-change operations.

Title: M01-US02: Men's Fashion Page Handles Broken Product Images Gracefully
Description: Verifies that when one or more product images on the Men's Fashion page are broken or fail to load — simulated via a controlled network block in browser developer tools — the page does not display broken-image icons as acceptable behavior, and the rest of the page remains usable without UI disruption. A broken image must not be treated as expected correct behavior.

Title: M01-US01: Carousel Navigation Controls and Keyboard Interaction Function Correctly
Description: Verifies that the carousel's navigation controls are actual focusable UI elements and that keyboard interaction using supported keys correctly advances and retreats between slides. This test ensures accessibility compliance for keyboard-only users navigating the hero carousel.

Title: M01-US04: Password Field Masks Input Characters on the Login Form
Description: Verifies that the password input field on the FashionStack login form masks entered characters so that the password is obscured and not exposed in the UI. The entered characters must appear as dots or asterisks (or equivalent masking characters) and must not be readable as plain text.

Title: M01-US03: Add to Cart Without Selecting Required Size Does Not Update Cart Counter
Description: Verifies that when a user attempts to add 'Silk Wrap Dress' to the cart without selecting a size, the cart counter does not update, the product is not added to the cart, and the system displays a clear validation response indicating the missing size selection. This is a negative test requiring a controlled condition where size selection is deliberately omitted.

Title: M01-US02: Men's Fashion Page Handles Missing Inventory and Incomplete Product List Gracefully
Description: Verifies that when the Men's Fashion page is loaded with a missing or incomplete product inventory — simulated via a documented controlled test condition (e.g., modified API response or controlled application state) — the page handles the condition gracefully without errors or UI breakage, and the rest of the page remains usable.
